# Accordion

Group: Data. Import: `import { Accordion } from 'lynn-ui';`

A stack of independently collapsible sections.
 Deliberately not an "only one open at a time" accordion: neither source behaves that way, and both reasons they don't are good ones - a reference panel is compared across sections, and an FAQ reader opens two questions at once.

## Usage

A layout wrapper and nothing more - it holds no state and passes no context, so each `AccordionItem` owns its own open flag. Use it to get the stacked spacing; a lone collapsible section works fine as a bare `AccordionItem`.

## Don't

Don't reach for this when you need exclusive "one open at a time" behavior - there is no mechanism here to close a sibling, and no prop will give you one.

## Props

- `children: ReactNode` - The `AccordionItem`s.
- `className?: string`
- `style?: CSSProperties`
